status: draft - from Cory's peer-review guideline; wording awaiting his review; licensing and conflict-of-interest items removed 2026-11-04 (not our wheelhouse). Ids of removed items are retired, not reused.

items.looks_for: Address, client, report date, inspection date and version agree throughout.
items.leading_question: The report's dates and identifying details are worth a quick match-up, since they don't all line up. Ask: Which dates and address are correct?
items.record_request: Could you send the corrected page or your inspection log?

items.looks_for: Weather and outdoor conditions on the day are recorded.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't show the weather on the day, which matters for outdoor comparisons. Ask: What were the outdoor conditions?
items.record_request: Could you share your field notes?

items.looks_for: Occupied or vacant, HVAC running or not, and windows and doors are recorded.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't say whether the HVAC was running or the building was closed up during the visit. Ask: What was the state of the building and HVAC?
items.record_request: Could you share your field notes?

items.looks_for: The reason is stated (complaint, visible growth, water event, sale, other).
items.leading_question: The report doesn't state why the assessment was done. Ask: What question was this assessment meant to answer?
items.record_request: Could you share the signed scope or agreement?

items.looks_for: Areas included and excluded are defined.
items.leading_question: It isn't clear which areas were and weren't covered. Ask: Which areas were included and which were left out?
items.record_request: Could you share the scope of work?

items.looks_for: A working question or hypothesis is stated.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't show the question the sampling was meant to test. Ask: What was each sample meant to answer?
items.record_request: Could you share your notes on the plan?

items.looks_for: What was delivered matches the agreement, and changes are explained.
items.leading_question: I couldn't compare what was done to what was agreed. Ask: Did the work match the agreed scope, and what changed?
items.record_request: Could you share the signed scope of work?

items.looks_for: Age, construction, roof, cladding and HVAC type are described.
items.leading_question: The report gives little about how the building is built. Ask: Can you describe the construction and HVAC system?
items.record_request: Could you share your notes?

items.looks_for: Leaks, floods, storms, repairs and earlier remediation are noted.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't describe the building's water history. Ask: What leaks or repairs were reported, and when?
items.record_request: Could you share the interview notes?

items.looks_for: When symptoms or odors started and where, recorded without medical claims.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't show what the occupants told the assessor. Ask: What did the occupants report and when did it start?
items.record_request: Could you share your interview notes?

items.looks_for: Earlier reports and remediation records were reviewed and referenced.
items.leading_question: The report mentions earlier work but doesn't say it was reviewed. Ask: Were the earlier records reviewed?
items.record_request: Could you share which records you saw?

items.looks_for: The inspection approach is described (room by room, attic, mechanical, crawlspace, exterior).
items.leading_question: The report doesn't describe how the building was walked through. Ask: Which spaces were inspected, and in what order?
items.record_request: Could you share your inspection notes?

items.looks_for: Each area records growth (where, size, material), staining, damage and conditions.
items.leading_question: Some areas don't say what was seen there. Ask: What was observed in each area, including where nothing was found?
items.record_request: Could you share your field notes and photos?

items.looks_for: Estimated square feet of visible growth per location.
items.leading_question: Visible growth is described without a size. Ask: About how large is each area of growth?
items.record_request: Could you share your measurements or photos with scale?

items.looks_for: The material the growth or staining is on is named.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't say what the growth or staining is on. Ask: What material is affected in each location?
items.record_request: Could you share your photos?

items.looks_for: Growth is called suspected unless a lab confirmed it.
items.leading_question: The report uses firm wording for growth that wasn't lab confirmed. Ask: Was this confirmed by a sample or seen by eye?
items.record_request: Could you share the lab confirmation, if any?

items.looks_for: Staining, discoloration and dark areas are described with location.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't describe staining or discoloration where it matters. Ask: Were any stains or dark areas seen, and where?
items.record_request: Could you share your photos?

items.looks_for: Swelling, rust, rot, warping or crumbling is described.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't say whether materials showed swelling, rust, rot or warping. Ask: What condition were the materials in?
items.record_request: Could you share your photos?

items.looks_for: Whether there was an odor, where, and what kind.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't say whether there was an odor. Ask: Was there a musty or other smell, and where?
items.record_request: Could you share your field notes?

items.looks_for: Whether hidden areas (behind cabinets, in walls) were opened or only noted.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't say whether hidden areas were opened. Ask: Which hidden areas were opened, and which weren't?
items.record_request: Could you share your photos or notes?

items.looks_for: The air handler, coil, drain pan, condensate line, plenums and filters were checked.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't show the HVAC was looked at, even though air quality is the concern. Ask: What was checked on the HVAC system?
items.record_request: Could you share your HVAC notes or photos?

items.looks_for: Grading, gutters, flashing, penetrations and roof were checked.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't describe the building exterior. Ask: Was the outside checked for water entry?
items.record_request: Could you share your exterior notes?

items.looks_for: Conclusions are limited to areas the assessor entered.
items.leading_question: The report draws conclusions about an area it doesn't say was entered. Ask: Was this area inspected?
items.record_request: Could you share your notes on access?

items.looks_for: Anything called wet or damp is identified.
items.leading_question: The report describes wet or damp conditions. Ask: Where exactly, and how was that determined?
items.record_request: Could you share your readings?

items.looks_for: Wetness was measured and the instrument type, model and scale are named.
items.leading_question: The report calls an area wet but doesn't name the meter or scale. Ask: What instrument and setting were used?
items.record_request: Could you share the meter details?

items.looks_for: A dry standard was taken on site from a like material, or a general standard is named.
items.leading_question: The report calls the wall wet, but doesn't show what it was compared to. Ask: What dry reading did you compare this to?
items.record_request: Could you share the dry reference reading?

items.looks_for: Readings are reported with location, material, value and scale (table or map).
items.leading_question: The readings aren't laid out by location. Ask: Can I see the readings by location?
items.record_request: Could you share your moisture map or table?

items.looks_for: Thermal images are screening only, confirmed by a meter, with conditions noted.
items.leading_question: The report uses thermal imaging to suggest moisture. Ask: Was it confirmed with a moisture meter?
items.record_request: Could you share the meter readings for that spot?

items.looks_for: Temperature, humidity and dew point indoors and out are recorded.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't show indoor and outdoor humidity and temperature. Ask: What were the conditions?
items.record_request: Could you share your field readings?

items.looks_for: A source is named for each growth area, or marked as not determined with next steps.
items.leading_question: Growth is described without a moisture source. Ask: What is the likely source, or is it not yet determined?
items.record_request: Could you share your notes on source?

items.looks_for: The report says whether moisture is active or historical.
items.leading_question: It isn't clear whether the moisture is current or from the past. Ask: Is the moisture active today?
items.record_request: Could you share your readings and notes?

items.looks_for: Each sample has a stated purpose tied to the question.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't explain why each sample was taken where it was. Ask: What was each sample meant to test?
items.record_request: Could you share your sampling plan?

items.looks_for: The reason a general room sample was or wasn't taken at an accessible central point.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't say why a general sample from the middle of the room wasn't also taken. Ask: Why were these spots chosen?
items.record_request: Could you share your notes?

items.looks_for: The sampling method fits the question (tape for visible growth, cavity or spore trap for air).
items.leading_question: The method may not fit the question being asked. Ask: Why was this method chosen?
items.record_request: Could you share your plan?

items.looks_for: A control from a similar clean surface was taken for comparison.
items.leading_question: A comparison sample from a similar clean surface would help show what is normal for this material. Ask: Was one taken?
items.record_request: Could you share the control result?

items.looks_for: An outdoor sample taken at the same time, or an indoor non-complaint control when outdoors isn't suitable.
items.leading_question: I couldn't find an outdoor comparison taken at the same time. Ask: Was an outdoor sample collected?
items.record_request: Could you share the outdoor result?

items.topic: Cavity and cabinet samples kept apart
items.looks_for: Samples from inside cabinets or wall cavities are not compared with room air.
items.leading_question: Samples from inside a cabinet or wall are compared against room air. Ask: How should those be read?
items.record_request: Could you share your reasoning?

items.looks_for: Sample locations are shown on a plan or photos.
items.leading_question: The sample locations aren't shown on a plan or photo. Ask: Where exactly was each taken?
items.record_request: Could you share your floor plan and photos?

items.looks_for: Duration, flow rate and volume are recorded.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't show how long and how fast each sample was drawn. Ask: What were the time, flow and volume?
items.record_request: Could you share your field sheet?

items.looks_for: The pump was calibrated before and after.
items.leading_question: I couldn't find pump calibration records. Ask: Were the pumps calibrated before and after?
items.record_request: Could you share the calibration record?

items.looks_for: Doors, HVAC state, disturbance and occupants during sampling.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't say what the conditions were while sampling. Ask: Was the HVAC running and were doors closed?
items.record_request: Could you share your field notes?

items.looks_for: Field blanks were used where the method calls for them.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't mention field blanks. Ask: Were any collected?
items.record_request: Could you share the blank results?

items.looks_for: A complete, signed chain of custody matches the report's sample IDs.
items.leading_question: I couldn't find the chain of custody. Ask: Can I see it?
items.record_request: Could you share the chain-of-custody form?

items.looks_for: The lab is accredited for the analysis.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't show the lab's accreditation. Ask: Which accreditation does the lab hold?
items.record_request: Could you share it?

items.looks_for: The original lab report is attached and its numbers match the report's tables.
items.leading_question: The numbers in the report can be compared to the lab sheet. Ask: Can I see the original lab report?
items.record_request: Could you share the original lab PDF?

items.topic: Values placed under the right location
items.looks_for: Each lab value sits under the correct location and sample ID.
items.leading_question: The summary and the lab table don't agree on where the highest result came from. Worth asking which is right.
items.record_request: Could you share the lab report and chain of custody?

items.looks_for: Units, raw counts and detection limits are understood and reported correctly.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't show units or detection limits clearly. Ask: What are the units and the lowest amount the lab can detect?
items.record_request: Could you share the lab report?

items.looks_for: Background debris on spore traps is noted.
items.leading_question: The debris level on the spore traps isn't mentioned. Ask: How heavy was the debris?
items.record_request: Could you share the lab report?

items.looks_for: Lab comments and qualifiers appear in the interpretation.
items.leading_question: Lab comments don't seem to carry into the interpretation. Ask: Were there lab notes about these samples?
items.record_request: Could you share the lab report?

items.looks_for: Interpretation combines what was seen, moisture, history and samples; samples are not read alone.
items.leading_question: The conclusions seem to lean on sample results alone. Ask: How do the visual and moisture findings fit in?
items.record_request: Could you share your reasoning?

items.looks_for: Totals and the types of spores present are compared indoors and out.
items.leading_question: The comparison to outdoor air isn't shown. Ask: How do indoor and outdoor results compare?
items.record_request: Could you share the outdoor result?

items.looks_for: No numeric safe or unsafe level is presented as a standard.
items.leading_question: The report uses a number as a dividing line between normal and elevated. Ask: What is the source of that number?
items.record_request: Could you share the reference?

items.looks_for: Indicator molds are discussed in context, not as automatic proof.
items.leading_question: Certain molds are treated as proof of water damage. Ask: What else supports that?
items.record_request: Could you share your reasoning?

items.looks_for: One-time sampling and spore variability are acknowledged.
items.leading_question: The report doesn't mention that a single sample reflects one moment. Ask: How representative are these results?

items.looks_for: Outdoor entry, recent disturbance, cleaning and debris are considered.
items.leading_question: Other possible explanations aren't discussed. Ask: What else could explain these results?

items.looks_for: No medical diagnosis or health predictions.
items.leading_question: The report touches on health effects. Ask: What is that based on?

items.looks_for: Each conclusion points to a photo, reading or sample ID.
items.leading_question: Some conclusions don't point to the finding behind them. Ask: What supports this conclusion?
items.record_request: Could you share the supporting photo, reading or sample?

items.looks_for: Conclusions answer the stated objectives.
items.leading_question: The conclusions don't clearly answer the original question. Ask: What is the answer to the question this assessment set out to address?

items.looks_for: Confirmed growth, suspected hidden growth, moisture without growth and no findings are kept distinct.
items.leading_question: These categories are blended together. Ask: Which areas are confirmed, which suspected, and which clear?

items.looks_for: Cause of moisture is stated as confirmed, probable, possible or not determined.
items.leading_question: A cause is stated firmly. Ask: How confident is it, and what supports it?
items.record_request: Could you share your supporting notes?

items.looks_for: No conclusion is contradicted by the report's own data.
items.leading_question: The report says no moisture was found, then describes chronic moisture. Ask the inspector to explain how both are true.

items.looks_for: Moisture source correction comes before remediation, with the right trade named.
items.leading_question: Remediation is recommended before the moisture source is addressed. Ask: What fixes the source first, and who does it?

items.looks_for: Each recommendation points to the measurement, sample or observation behind it.
items.leading_question: The report recommends this work. It doesn't yet show the measurement or sample behind that. Ask what supports it.
items.record_request: Could you share the supporting reading or sample?

items.looks_for: Remediation scope matches the measured area of growth.
items.leading_question: The scope of work may be larger than the area shown. Ask: How does the scope relate to the measured growth?

items.looks_for: Further investigation is advised where hidden conditions are suspected.
items.leading_question: The report suspects hidden conditions without a next step. Ask: What further checking is advised?

items.looks_for: Post-remediation checks are defined in advance (visual, moisture, sampling).
items.leading_question: The report doesn't say how success will be judged after remediation. Ask: What will be checked, and what counts as clear?

items.looks_for: Limitations name the real inaccessible areas, not only boilerplate.
items.leading_question: The limitations are general and don't name the areas that weren't reached. Ask: Which areas weren't accessible?
items.record_request: Could you share your access notes?

items.looks_for: Photos are labeled with location, finding and date, and referenced in the text.
items.leading_question: Some photos aren't labeled with what they show. Ask: Can I have the labels?
items.record_request: Could you share the photo log?

items.looks_for: A plan shows sample locations, readings and growth areas.
items.leading_question: There's no plan showing where things were found. Ask: Can I see a sketch?
items.record_request: Could you share your sketch?

items.looks_for: The summary doesn't claim more or less than the body.
items.leading_question: The summary and the body of the report don't match. Ask: Which is correct?

items.looks_for: Numbers, units and spelling are consistent.
items.leading_question: A few numbers or units look inconsistent. Ask: Which values are correct?
